metaDescription: Savannah vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Savannah boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Savannah owners tracking 12-20 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where panleukopenia risk concentrates for this kitten.
Use the 4-row Savannah schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (FVRCP); 12 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for Savannah handling: Hybrid serval descendant; husbandry and legality vary; health data incomplete.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Savannah dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Savannah core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Savannah boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the kitten and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Savannah row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra FVRCP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Savannah item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Savannah kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Savannah due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Savannah core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Savannah misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Savannah health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Savannah adult health guide for breed predispositions such as limited long-term clinical dataset by filial generation, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
